title: TOP SECRET BYEMAN control cover sheet with handwritten 'Prod — Project UFO's' note
description: High-contrast photocopy of a TOP SECRET BYEMAN control-system cover sheet form (hatched black border, ADB/DSD/SI routing grid) restricting access to persons cleared for project OXCART. Handwritten annotations at top read 'Prod — Project UFO's' and '11 Feb 65 1958-196…'; handwritten '232' at left. Espionage-laws warning block at bottom.
